runs.text: Name the three ingredients plants need
Write the word equation for photosynthesis
Read results from a simple experiment
Light is the energy source, not an ingredient — that’s why we write it above the arrow.
• When did the dark plant stop growing?
• What does this tell us about light?
Which gas do plants release during photosynthesis?
“The leaves of a single large tree can release enough oxygen in a day for a family of four.”
• Photosynthesis happens in the chloroplasts of leaf cells
• Chlorophyll absorbs light — and makes leaves green
• Plants use glucose for energy and growth
Homework: label the leaf diagram on page 42 · due Friday
